title: Razor Crest
subtitle: Ride For Hire
text: When a Pilot attaches to this unit: You may return a non-leader unit that costs 2 or less or an exhausted non-leader unit that costs 4 or less to its owner's hand.
rules:
Abilities that refer to a card’s cost always refer to its printed cost, regardless of modifiers.
Abilities that return a card to hand must choose a card in play unless otherwise specified.
